posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Santa Guise keeps showing up via random. Maybe it's because I forgot him during that big "every villain" thing. c.c Anyway, today he led Sky-Scraper, Captain Cosmic, TLT and Bunker in another advanced Citizen Dawn campaign, this time in the Dok'thorath Capital. It wasn't a good idea. :( Believe it or not, Guise made everything worse.
 
So then it was off to Atlantis, where Chono-Ranger, F6 Tempest and Omnitron-U took on Voss's advanced army. How do you say "it was a complete rout" in Atlantean?
 
But heroes never give up! How about F6 Unity, Scholar and F6 AZ fighting advanced Plague Rat in the Enclave? He got in some good hits, and the heroes were hurting, but he ended up rethinking his life choices by the end.
 
Baron Blade got advanced angry and tried to BOMB CHAOS. He was actually pretty good at it, and helped out Omnitron-U, Visionary and TLT on the first round. Tachyon crushed him a few rounds later for his hubris.
 
Then it off to the Time Cataclysm! Advanced Skinwalker versus Guise, Scholar of the Infinite, Argent Adept, Nightmist and the Wraith! Do you know, if Nightmist is in Mist Form and Oppressive Smog is out, Skinny G will slowly destroy himself on his flip side? Well, unless the Pouch of Bones is out. Nightmist can do a looot of damage to Gloomy and his army all on her lonesome, though. Sadly, it was not enough to win the day, and thus despair reigned across all of time and space, the end.
 
Lately, I've taken to setting up games to play out final battles from superhero movies, TV shows, etc. Today, it was Suicide Squad, starring Chrono-Ranger as Rick Flag, DW Expatriette as Deadshot, Guise as Harley Quinn, Haka as Killer Croc and Ra as El Diablo, fighting Gloomweaver (cuz I didn't feel like a Matriarch battle) in Megalopolis, because those movies are always in cities. It was a quick and easy relic victory. I can't remember the last time I got that much use out of Wrathful Gaze! Also, Suicide Squad was just kind of okay, for the record.
